title: Methodological approach for fast high-resolution image selection: FAHRIS algorithm
author: Åsebø, Cavazzani, et al.

steps.title: Set up analysis workstation
steps.instruction: Use a Lenovo Yoga Slim 7i Pro 14 laptop equipped with an 11th‑generation Intel® Core™ i7‑11370H processor, 16 GB LPDDR4X‑4266 MHz RAM, NVIDIA® GeForce® MX450 2 GB GDDR6 GPU, 512 GB SSD, running Windows 11 Home 64‑bit, and keep it connected to a power source during processing.

steps.title: Load image datasets
steps.instruction: Transfer the image files from the three flight campaigns (Florence balloon, Treviso drone, Padua drone) onto the workstation.

steps.title: Classify images with FAHRIS
steps.instruction: Run the FAHRIS classification system on all loaded images to evaluate motion blur against the predetermined threshold and retain only the images classified as acceptable.

steps.title: Organize accepted images into groups
steps.instruction: Sort the accepted images into four grouping categories: (1) Date, (2) Time, (3) Geographical location (latitude/longitude), and (4) Altitude.

steps.title: Stitch images per dataset and group
steps.instruction: For each dataset, stitch the accepted images within each group, recording the number of stitched images used and the stitching duration as reported.
